_comment: Real tiers from the marketing pricing page. creditRateUsd is priceUsd/creditsPerMonth for each paid tier -- the real spending power one Amaz Credit represents at that tier, which is why it gets cheaper (more credits per dollar) at higher tiers. Explore has no natural rate of its own ($0/month), so it uses Personal's rate as its reference. stripePriceId is filled in by scripts/stripe_setup.py; a plan with stripePriceId: null cannot be checked out yet, the same way seats.json's modelId: null means a seat cannot be provisioned yet.
